Mexico Captures FBI-Wanted Drug Lord 'El Chapo Isidro' in Deadly Raid

Mexican special forces captured Isidro Garza, also known as 'El Chapo Isidro,' an FBI-wanted drug lord, in a raid that involved helicopters, explosions, and gunfire. The operation resulted in chaos and violence. Garza is described as one of Mexico's most notorious drug lords and was on the FBI's most-wanted list. This capture is part of a series of arrests of drug kingpins.
